# Issue #5: settings provenance and historical-input regression tests

[English](README.md) | [日本語](../../../../ja/test_case/offline/issue5/README.md) | [Français](../../../../fr/test_case/offline/issue5/README.md) | [中文](../../../../../test_case/offline/issue5/README.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

From the repository root, run `npm run test:issue5` or full `npm run verify`. Each scenario uses a temporary Store and synthetic stream to inspect Host behavior and actual model requests.

Coverage includes empty extraction, existing commitment retention, historical Master originals after settings application, later trimming/restart, multi-tool protocol pairing, source-identity matching, capacity changes, legacy trim mappings, and corrupt evidence. Assertions inspect request contents for originals; summaries use controllable fixtures.

See the [Settings guide](../../../data-flow.md#memory-maintenance-and-settings) for current behavior. First failures, reviews, and test environments are preserved in the [2026-10-08 summary](../../../../../test_case/reports/memory-review-20261008/README.md).
